selected_branches.branch: Destination stopping near a marked crosswalk

law_text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within twenty feet of any marked crosswalk.
